landing.about.lede: Excellence in systems. Impact in action — through clearer workflows and services that matter.
landing.about.platform: This platform is part of Beacon’s work with SMEs: one enterprise record connecting finances, compliance, readiness, and referral — Arabic-first and mobile-ready.
landing.about.focus.systems_desc: Clear workflows that help teams follow progress without technical noise.
landing.about.focus.compliance_desc: Requirements and documents in a structure Beacon can manage and update.
landing.about.focus.impact_desc: Services that move an enterprise forward step by step toward better readiness.
landing.about.cta_body: For more about the firm and its services, visit the website or write to the team.
landing.cases.title: Case studies
landing.cases.lede: Illustrative journeys based on how the platform supports SMEs — without invented financing figures or approval claims.
landing.cases.records.title: From scattered notes to a clear daily ledger
landing.cases.records.body: An enterprise recorded sales and expenses on separate papers. After entering daily movements and uploading receipts, the owner and Beacon advisor could review the same picture anytime.
landing.cases.records.outcome: A reviewable financial record instead of memory and scattered paper.
landing.cases.compliance.title: Seeing requirements before the deadline
landing.cases.compliance.body: Instead of discovering missing documents late, requirements and incomplete items appeared in one screen, with clear follow-up on what was done and what still needed action.
landing.cases.compliance.outcome: Ordered compliance actions and fewer missed deadlines.
landing.cases.referral.title: Preparing a referral package with explicit consent
landing.cases.referral.body: After basic records and a readiness review, a referral package was prepared and the enterprise saw what would be shared and with whom — before any external sharing.
landing.cases.referral.outcome: An organised referral with documented consent, without premature or unclear sharing.
landing.cases.cta_body: Supporting enterprises in a Beacon programme? Contact us to see how the platform is used in follow-up.

landing.cases.disclaimer: An illustrative story of an SME journey on the platform. Not a financing approval or guaranteed outcome.
landing.cases.records.lede: How an enterprise moved from scattered paper notes to a daily ledger shared with its advisor.
landing.cases.records.challenge: Sales and expenses were kept on separate paper notebooks, so it was hard to see the full picture or share the same information quickly with an advisor.
landing.cases.records.approach: The owner started entering daily movements and uploading supporting receipts, so the financial record became one shared reference for the enterprise and Beacon advisor.
landing.cases.records.step_1: Record income and expenses with a clear date and amount.
landing.cases.records.step_2: Upload receipts and link them to movements when available.
landing.cases.records.step_3: Review the summary with the advisor from the same record.
landing.cases.compliance.lede: How requirements and missing items became visible before a deadline turned into a crisis.
landing.cases.compliance.challenge: Documents and requirements were tracked irregularly, so gaps were often discovered late.
landing.cases.compliance.approach: Requirements and each item’s status appeared on one screen, with clear follow-up on what was complete and what still needed action.
landing.cases.compliance.step_1: Review the requirements shown for the enterprise.
landing.cases.compliance.step_2: Upload missing documents or update their status.
landing.cases.referral.lede: How a referral package was prepared only after explicit consent about what would be shared and with whom.
landing.cases.referral.challenge: Before any information is shared with a financing institution, the enterprise needs to see the recipient, purpose, and content clearly.
landing.cases.referral.approach: After basic records and a readiness review, the package was prepared and shown to the enterprise for consent before any external sharing.
landing.cases.referral.step_1: Complete basic records and review readiness.
landing.cases.referral.step_2: Prepare the referral package and review its content.
